slides.title: Read this if your house got away from you again
slides.sub: Save it for the next time too

slides.title: You didn't fail. Life got loud and the house got quiet attention. That's allowed.
Pick one visible win
slides.body: Clear the spot you see first in the morning. One clear spot tells your brain it's not too late.

slides.title: Lower the bar on purpose
slides.body: Paper plates this week are a plan, not a failure. Make the next few days easier on purpose.

slides.title: Ask for a body double
slides.body: Call a friend while you load the dishwasher. Company makes starting feel lighter.

slides.title: Count what you did
slides.body: Write down 3 things you did today. Even 'took the trash out' goes on the list.

slides.title: Keep a bad-day plan on the fridge
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a printable 'restart day' page for exactly this. Link in bio.
